summary: 0.2.9 improves CEE train gauge recovery, overhead chunk loading, and alternator output while unloaded.
changes: Train voltage and current needles recover when readings return. They stay hidden while readings are unavailable.
Saved overhead spans stay active as passive holders load. Mixed circuits still wait for their real dependencies.
Two-terminal and three-phase CEE alternators keep supplying power from saved drive state while unloaded.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.262, Java 21, Create 6.0.10, CEE 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.12. Set PG multiTicks to 16. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Use the 0.2.9 dependency set in the installation guide. Some inner save instructions list earlier dependency versions. The combined Stationary Yard requires CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and Pinout 0.2.1. Fuse and rotary-selector circuit examples require Power Components 1.3.0.
